artworks.title: Head of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: black chalk on paper laid down on panel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person's face and upper shoulders. The person is depicted facing us but looking to the left with a neutral expression. They have high cheekbones, a long, straight nose, thin eyebrows, round eyes, and short curly hair framing their face. Their clothing is minimal, but we can see a hint of a collar around their neck. The background is plain beige paper.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of the Ten Thousand
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, with unrelated short pen strokes
artworks.description: The image features an elevated viewpoint showing multiple elements. The horizon line is high, nearly aligning with the top of a distant hill. Small figures are visible on the hill, along with a structure on the peak. The artwork is done in red chalk strokes, depicting figures and landscape with precision. The composition is monochromatic with varying shades of warm red on a cream background. Closest to the viewer are clustered figures, some with elongated objects. Moving back, smaller figures are scattered on a sloped terrain, adding depth. In the distance, the hill dominates the skyline, creating a sense of tranquility and expansiveness.

artworks.title: Groups of Male Figures
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing that shows several groups of people sketched in red chalk. All figures are drawn in full length, each with their body in profile or a three-quarter view. The men are depicted standing in various postures; some with their arms crossed or hands on hips. The figures have simple facial features and medium-length, wavy hair. The clothing appears to be form-fitting, and there is no jewelry or distinctive objects noted being held by anyone. The background is a blank, textured surface.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man
artworks.medium: colored chalks on blue laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up portrait of a man's head and face, emphasizing his facial features and hair. His head is slightly tilted downward, with eyes closed or looking down, showing the top portion and side of his face. He has a red beard and mustache, with short, dark, and messy or brushed back hair. The drawing is done in soft tones with a textured appearance created by a mix of chalks. There are no visible clothing or jewelry. The background is a plain, neutral-colored surface.

artworks.title: Fantasy of a Façade with Bizarre Ornaments
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure with sculptural decorations. The image depicts an elaborately decorated facade or possibly a section of a classical building, featuring highly detailed carvings and artistic elements. The drawing shows several layers of ornamental moldings, friezes with human figures, and various architectural elements like pilasters and capitals adorned with intricate floral and scrollwork designs. Central to the composition is a prominent medallion with the profile of a head, surrounded by lion sculptures and other decorative motifs. The lower section includes detailed floral designs and figures in medallions, showcasing a rich and complex interplay of artistic elements.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman [recto]
artworks.medium: silverpoint with brush and black and brown ink over charcoal and leadpoint, heightened with white on white prepared paper
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a woman’s body faces us as she looks slightly off to our left in this vertical drawing. Her face and features are shaded in detail with white highlights that suggest pale skin. She has round eyes with heavy lids under lightly raised brows, a straight nose, and full lips in an oval-shaped face. Her headdress wraps around her neck and head and falls over her shoulders. She is enclosed by a drawn frame with rounded corners at the top and a curved bottom. The artist’s initials are partially visible within the frame near the lower right, “H.H.” Ink writing was added to a few areas of the drawing or has transferred from another page to this image.

artworks.title: Study of a Bearded Man [verso]
artworks.medium: silverpoint and charcoal heightened with white on white prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man's head and shoulders. The man is facing forward, with long hair, a bushy beard reaching his chest, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. The hair is wavy and slightly unkempt. There are no visible items of clothing or jewelry. The sketch is done on textured paper, giving the background an aged, rustic appearance, with faint pencil strokes framing the figure.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with white wash on blue prepared paper
artworks.description: This image shows the head and upper body of a person drawn in an intricate linear style. The person is facing the viewer with their head slightly turned to the side. They have a full beard, bushy eyebrows, deeply furrowed brow, and intense eyes. The person's hair is wavy and windswept, with a band holding it back. The hair is detailed with complex texture. They wear a garment with a frilled collar, visible around the neck. The background is a muted blue-grey, providing contrast to the drawing. The artwork is in a monochromatic palette on colored paper.

artworks.title: The Backplate of a Suit of Parade Armor
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and faint traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design with mythical figures and decorative motifs. The composition includes acanthus leaves and abstracted floral forms, interspersed with figures resembling mythological deities and creatures. The central area presents figures in flowing robes and armor. The detailed line work creates depth and texture, capturing motion and complexity.

artworks.title: Philippe Mengin de Bionval
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the upper half of a man's body in profile. The man has distinctive facial features with a pronounced nose, sharp jawline, and sideburns. His hair is curly and relatively short. The man is dressed in a coat with high collars and a shirt with a cravat. The drawing has a plain, light background. There are no visible objects held by the person. A signature and date written on the bottom right corner indicate "Ingres à Rome, 1812."

artworks.title: Fantasy Farmhouse
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash with touches of red-brown crayon, surface scraping on Bristol board
artworks.description: The image depicts a countryside village with thatched roof buildings against a cloudy sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing texture in grass and thatch. The color scheme is monochromatic, featuring shades of sepia and black. A pond with ducks is in the foreground, leading to the village buildings in the middle ground, which fade into the distance. Clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person in a side profile. The person has a straight nose, full lips, and eyes looking forward. Their hair is wavy and frames the sides of the head. The subject wears a garment that appears to be a shirt or jacket, with subtle details blending into the background. The background is plain, rendered in reddish-brown tones on light, textured paper. No jewelry or objects are visible, and the paper's edges are slightly frayed.

artworks.title: Perspective View of the Interior of a Metropolitan Church
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash over graphite on laid paper, with framing line in brown chalk
artworks.description: The drawing shows an architectural interior with enormous arches and long columns. It features a room with multiple connected dome ceilings decorated with square panels above rows of columns along the sides of the space. Wispy clouds float up into the dome's top, far above the ground. In the distance, throughout several long, column-lined halls, is a white arched opening. Closest to us, at the bottom of the drawing, there is a long set of stairs with two statues to the left and right of center. Upon closer inspection, miniscule people become visible on the stairs and on the long floor of the hall. The people wear robes and sit and stand in groups.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an arrangement of curving lines forming abstract shapes resembling leaves or coral in colors including blue, orange, and red. These shapes encircle a central area of text. There are motifs resembling a lattice bridge, a small pagoda, and a figure leading an animal within the design.

artworks.title: Arabesque with a Double Parasol
artworks.medium: etching inked à la poupée in gray, black, blue, green-blue, olive green, pink, and yellow-brown
artworks.description: The image depicts a collection of curving lines and archways creating an abstract composition. Figures resembling humans in period clothing are present on various platforms, with one holding an umbrella. Delicate branches with floral and leaf motifs are intertwined throughout. A prominent umbrella is featured twice in the image. A face with a hat emerges from the top center, blending into the foliage. The design is detailed and whimsical, potentially reminiscent of a garden or treehouse.

artworks.title: Arabesque with a Monkey
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate arrangement of curved lines and shapes forming an abstract design. There is a curving staircase leading to a small pagoda-like structure. Surrounding the structure are floral and fern-like patterns, along with hanging objects and vases. Animal figures resembling monkeys or exotic birds are also present throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Arabesque with a Boat
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a fantastical garden scene with whimsical elements and intricate, delicate structures. The painting depicts an arrangement of floral and arboreal forms creating a tapestry-like composition, interwoven with intricate patterns of latticework and figures engaged in various activities atop these structures. Small animals are perched within the branches, while vibrant colors of blues, pinks, and earthy tones create a vivid visual tapestry. Imaginary elements blend in, including a small boat at the bottom right corner with a bright orange load. The use of color and whimsical subjects suggest inspiration drawn from 18th-century European decorative arts. This is in the style of Jean-Baptiste Pillement.

artworks.title: Arabesque with a Tightrope Walker
artworks.medium: etching inked à la poupée in black, gray, blue, green, golden-brown, pink, and olive green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a garden scene with intricate architectural and botanical elements. The scene includes structures like bridges and pagodas adorned with hanging drapery, ribbons, tassels, and garlands. The foliage and flowers are detailed in various pastel hues, and small birds are perched throughout the scene. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Baptiste Pillement, showcasing a chinoiserie influence.

artworks.title: The Dead Caesar
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person lying down, covered in draped fabric that obscures their form. The face is partially visible under the fabric, with the hair and feet exposed. The background is simple, focusing on the figure and fabric details. The drawing is signed by the artist in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: A Satyr
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper; laid down, with framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: A muscular man stands with one hand on a walking stick and the other braced on the underside of a stone block above his head in this full-length, vertical drawing. The man’s body faces our left in profile, but he turns his face to look up and off to the right. Short, curling horns nestle among his curly hair, and he has a curly goatee. He has a furry brow, like a goat, a flattened nose, and drooping eyes. His lips are parted, and his top eye teeth and bottom middle teeth show. His right hand, to our left, reaches up to the stone overhead. He holds his other arm across his body to brace that hand on a waist-high staff. He stands with his weight on his left foot, closer to us, and his other ankle crosses in front so the balls of that foot rest on the ground. A rectangular frame is drawn with brown ink, and the corners are shaded sage green. More drawn frames suggest stepped molding within a frosty green band. Cursive text in the lower right corner reads, “alla porta di fontana Bellio di bronzo p piu di dua volte il vivo b 7 erano dua variati.”

artworks.title: Corner of a Rustic Barn
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew Robison, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic structure made of intertwined branches and vines, resembling a small hut or shelter. The focus is on the detailed construction of the structure. The brushstrokes, if present, create textures indicating natural materials. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey, black, and beige. The scene includes twigs, foliage, and the suggestion of a wall made from similar materials.

artworks.title: A Dock Harmony--Fishing Boats
artworks.medium: pastel on dark brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Robert G. Cleveland, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows boats densely packed together in a harbor or marina. The boats have tall masts and folded sails. There are hints of buildings or structures in the background, suggesting a shoreline or dock. The brushstrokes are fluid and expressive, capturing textures and movement. The color palette includes deep greens, browns, and hints of blue and tan, with reflections on the water's surface. The lighting suggests dusk or dawn.

artworks.title: Holofernes Interrogating Achior
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hubert and Michèle Prouté and Family, in memory of Jean Adhémar and Paul Prouté, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting of a detailed narrative scene with multiple figures in an ornate, classical style. The image is framed with an intricately designed border featuring floral and geometric patterns. Within the scene, an interior tent setting to the left shows a figure seated on an elevated round platform, listening to another armored figure gesturing. Around them stand other figures clad in armor and attire. To the right, the scene extends outdoors, depicting a landscape with a fortified town, a bridge, and figures engaged in various activities, including one tied to a tree. This elaborate scene suggests themes of military encounters, leadership, and interrogation. The style echoes the detailed narrative approach of Renaissance or Baroque painters.

artworks.title: Judith Goes to the Camp of Holofernes
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hubert and Michèle Prouté and Family, in memory of Jean Adhémar and Paul Prouté, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This painting shows a historical scene with detailed costumes. It features a group of people with colorful robes in an architectural setting. To the right, a woman interacts with another figure inside a decorated interior. The scenery outside includes hills and a cloudy sky, framed by architectural details. The painting's margins have ornamental patterns and floral designs, following a decorative style reminiscent of the Renaissance period.
